identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Restore strict Clippy after v1 tooling removal

values.summary: Bootstrap and approve the bounded design, bind #327, remove the unreachable helper, run focused CLI and strict-Clippy proof, obtain fresh exact-head review, publish, and finish only after required checks are green.

steps.action: Bootstrap, independently review, approve, doctor, and bind issue #327.
Remove only the unreachable real_tooling helper in the bound worktree.
Run focused CLI tests and strict all-target Clippy through typed validation evidence.
Obtain fresh exact-head review, publish a ready PR, observe required CI, and finish terminal if all gates permit.

invariants: Unsupported v1 tooling remains fail closed
Only the bound #327 worktree receives source edits
risks: A hidden caller could make removal behaviorally significant
Hosted CI may expose unrelated baseline failures
stop_conditions: Any live caller of real_tooling is found
Focused test or strict Clippy fails after the bounded correction
Fresh review reports an actionable finding
